title: WAF Firewall
desc: Based on Coraza and the OWASP Core Rule Set (CRS). Reference an instance from a Web service site to enable it
deleteConfirm: Delete this instance? Sites that reference it will no longer be inspected
paranoiaHelp: Higher is stricter with more false positives. Start from 1
bodyLimitHelp: 0 means the default 12.5 MB, up to 1024 MB
bodyLimitRejectHelp: Requests with a larger body get 413, so uploads of big files fail
bodyLimitPartialHelp: Only the part within the limit is inspected and the rest is passed to the backend unchanged; suited to sites that take big uploads, such as cloud drives and WebDAV
webdavHelp: Allows PUT, DELETE, PROPFIND, MKCOL, MOVE, COPY, LOCK and similar methods, the Lock-Token, If and Content-Range headers, and any upload content type; injection, path traversal and other attack checks still apply. For cloud drives, WebDAV and file managers
skipBodyPathsHelp: One path prefix per line, starting with /. Matching requests skip body inspection; headers, URL and query parameters are still inspected
crsPlaceholder: Leave empty to enable all rule files
